}

function seatAngle(i){return -i*Math.PI/3}
function sitAt(i,r){let a=seatAngle(i);return [Math.sin(a)*r,0,Math.cos(a)*r]}
/* STEP 5.4: real .glb mesh loading, with rig groups for head and hand. No fake billboard character meshes. */
const meshCache={};
function unpackGlb(id){
 if(meshCache[id])return meshCache[id];
 const raw=atob(CHARACTER_GLB[id]);const buf=new Uint8Array(raw.length);for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)buf[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);
 const dv=new DataView(buf.buffer);if(dv.getUint32(0,true)!==0x46546c67)throw Error('invalid GLB: '+id);
 let off=12,json=null,binOff=-1;
 while(off<buf.length){const len=dv.getUint32(off,true),kind=dv.getUint32(off+4,true);if(kind===0x4E4F534A)json=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buf.subarray(off+8,off+8+len)));if(kind===0x004E4942)binOff=off+8;off+=len+8}
 if(!json||binOff<0)throw Error('incomplete GLB '+id);
 const partlist=[];
 function acc(idx){let a=json.accessors[idx],v=json.bufferViews[a.bufferView],stride=v.byteStride||0,comp=a.componentType,cols=a.type==='VEC3'?3:a.type==='VEC2'?2:a.type==='VEC4'?4:1,size=comp===5126||comp===5125?4:2;
  let arr=new Array(a.count*cols);const step=stride||size*cols,base=binOff+(v.byteOffset||0)+(a.byteOffset||0);
  for(let n=0;n<a.count;n++)for(let j=0;j<cols;j++){let o=base+n*step+j*size;arr[n*cols+j]=comp===5126?dv.getFloat32(o,true):comp===5125?dv.getUint32(o,true):dv.getUint16(o,true)}return arr;
 }
 for(let node of json.nodes){if(node.mesh==null)continue;
  const phase=(node.name||'body').split('__')[0];
  for(let prim of json.meshes[node.mesh].primitives){const pos=acc(prim.attributes.POSITION),ids=acc(prim.indices);let norms=new Array(pos.length).fill(0),uv=new Array(pos.length/3*2).fill(0);
   // Static GLB files here contain triangulated geometry and no normal accessor. Compute smooth vertex normals.
   for(let j=0;j<ids.length;j+=3){let a=ids[j]*3,b=ids[j+1]*3,c=ids[j+2]*3;
    let ux=pos[b]-pos[a],uy=pos[b+1]-pos[a+1],uz=pos[b+2]-pos[a+2],vx=pos[c]-pos[a],vy=pos[c+1]-pos[a+1],vz=pos[c+2]-pos[a+2];
    let nx=uy*vz-uz*vy,ny=uz*vx-ux*vz,nz=ux*vy-uy*vx;
    for(let k of [a,b,c]){norms[k]+=nx;norms[k+1]+=ny;norms[k+2]+=nz}
   }
   for(let j=0;j<norms.length;j+=3){let l=Math.hypot(norms[j],norms[j+1],norms[j+2])||1;norms[j]/=l;norms[j+1]/=l;norms[j+2]/=l}
   const key='char_'+id+'_'+partlist.length;geo[key]=geom(pos,norms,uv,ids);
   let fac=json.materials[prim.material]?.pbrMetallicRoughness?.baseColorFactor||[1,1,1,1];let clr='#'+fac.slice(0,3).map(v=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(v*255))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
   partlist.push({key,clr,phase});
  }
 }
 meshCache[id]=partlist;return partlist;
}
function figure(parent,who,id){
 const group=make(parent,null,'#ffffff',[0,0,0]);const head=make(group,null,'#ffffff',[0,2.94,-.08]);const moving=make(group,null,'#ffffff',[0,0,0]);const eyeg=make(head,null,'#ffffff',[0,0,0]);
 const parts=unpackGlb(who.modelId);
 for(let part of parts){let host=part.phase==='head'?head:part.phase==='eye'?eyeg:part.phase==='hand'?moving:group;
  // GLB vertices are already in character-local absolute coordinates, with the face near Y=2.94.
  // Head/eye rig is pivoted at Y=2.94, Z=-0.08. Cancel that pivot for those meshes
  // so the neutral pose stays attached to the torso and animation rotates in place.
  const pivotCompensation=(part.phase==='head'||part.phase==='eye')?[0,-2.94,0.08]:[0,0,0];
  make(host,part.key,part.clr,pivotCompensation);
 }
 return {group,head,moving,eyes:[eyeg],bob:id*1.07,modelId:who.modelId};
}
function setNameTags(){el('playersList').innerHTML=seats.map((p,i)=>`<button class="player-btn" data-id="${i}" id="pbtn${i}"><span class="dot" style="--c:${p.shirt}">${i===0?'★':i}</span><span class="player-main"><span class="pname">${i===0?'คุณ (ผู้เล่น)':p.name}</span><br><span class="pdetail">${i===0?'ไพ่เห็นเฉพาะคุณ':'ไพ่ลับ 2 ใบ'}</span></span><span class="coin" id="coinList${i}">🟡 ${p.coins}</span></button>`).join('');for(let node of el('playersList').querySelectorAll('[data-id]'))node.onclick=()=>focusSeat(+node.dataset.id);

setNameTags();
function makeSeat(i){let p=seats[i],q=sitAt(i,4.14),angle=seatAngle(i);let base=make(root,null,'#ffffff',q,[1,1,1],[0,angle,0]);base.owner=i;
 const human=figure(base,p,i);human.group.hideInSeat=i===0;
 // Dark warm leather playmats help cards and tokens stay legible on the glowing wood.
 solidCube(base,'#6c4336',[0,1.535,-1.77],[2.35,.012,1.72]);
 solidCube(base,'#b38a55',[0,1.546,-1.77],[2.26,.004,1.63]);
 solidCube(base,'#734b3c',[0,1.55,-1.77],[2.23,.005,1.60]);
 let cards=[];for(let k=0;k<2;k++)cards.push(card(base,[k===0?-.36:.36,1.60,-1.70],p.roles[k],0));
 const bank=make(base,null,'#ffffff',[0,0,0]);
 const labelPlate=make(base,'box','#ae7a4d',[0,1.565,-2.50],[.68,.015,.075]);
 /* Coins are created by rebuildBank from the seat's current count. */
 return {base,human,bank,cards,world:sitAt(i,4.14),coinNodes:[],index:i}
}

function rebuildBank(i){let actor=actors[i],p=seats[i];actor.bank.children=[];for(let j=0;j<p.coins;j++){let col=j%4,row=Math.floor(j/4);coin(actor.bank,.77+col*.23,-1.72+row*.23,1.596)}el('coinList'+i).textContent='🟡 '+p.coins;el('coinTag'+i).textContent='✦ '+p.coins}
seats.forEach((_,i)=>rebuildBank(i));

function plant(x,z,r=1){let g=make(root,null,'#ffffff',[x,0,z],[r,r,r]);cyl(g,'#b47e5d',[0,.42,0],[.43,.5,.43]);cyl(g,'#6d4939',[0,.73,0],[.38,.03,.38]);cyl(g,'#507758',[0,1.0,0],[.08,.7,.08]);for(let j=0;j<7;j++){let a=j*Math.PI*2/7;ellipsoid(g,j%2?'#64946f':'#88aa6c',[Math.sin(a)*.37,1.30+(j%3)*.1,Math.cos(a)*.37],[.22,.43,.18],[0,a,Math.sin(a)*.54])}}

/* camera */
const camera={tgt:[0,1.54,-.2],yaw:0,pitch:.27,dist:8.8,desired:{tgt:[0,1.54,-.2],yaw:0,pitch:.27,dist:8.8}};
const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
const MIN_CAMERA_Y=2.42; // Floor and table-underside views are deliberately disabled.
function safePitch(tgt,dist,pitch){
 const minAboveTable=Math.asin(clamp((MIN_CAMERA_Y-tgt[1])/Math.max(dist,2.7),0,.96));
 return clamp(pitch,Math.max(.27,minAboveTable),1.36);
}
function targetCamera(d){
 const dist=clamp(d.dist,3.55,16.5),tgt=[...d.tgt];
 camera.desired={tgt,yaw:d.yaw,pitch:safePitch(tgt,dist,d.pitch),dist};
}
function mode(m){currentMode=m;document.querySelectorAll('#seatBtn,#tableBtn,#focusBtn').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));if(m==='seat'){el('seatBtn').classList.add('active');targetCamera({tgt:[0,1.63,-.1],yaw:0,pitch:.20,dist:8.55})}else if(m==='table'){el('tableBtn').classList.add('active');targetCamera({tgt:[0,1.18,0],yaw:0,pitch:1.12,dist:13.5})}else{el('focusBtn').classList.add('active');let v=sitAt(selected,4.14);targetCamera({tgt:[v[0],2.65,v[2]],yaw:Math.atan2(-v[0],-v[2]),pitch:.32,dist:4.15})}updateSelected()}
function updateSelected(){if(typeof updatePortrait==='function')updatePortrait();document.querySelectorAll('.player-btn').forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle('active',i===(demoRunning?activeVoice:selected)));document.querySelectorAll('.seat-label').forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle('active',i===(demoRunning?activeVoice:selected)))}
function focusSeat(i){if(demoRunning)stopDemo();selected=(i+6)%6;mode('focus');showBubble=false;el('bubble').style.visibility='hidden';el('turninfo').textContent=`◎ กำลังดู ${selected===0?'คุณ':seats[selected].name} · ผู้เล่น ${selected+1}/6`;updatePortrait()}
function changeZoom(d){camera.desired.dist=clamp(camera.desired.dist+d,3.55,16.5);camera.desired.pitch=safePitch(camera.desired.tgt,camera.desired.dist,camera.desired.pitch);}
function demoStep(){showBubble=true;activeVoice=selected;let i=selected;if(i===0)seats.forEach((p,j)=>{p.coins=2;rebuildBank(j)});if(i===1||i===3){seats[i].coins+=(i===1?1:3);rebuildBank(i)};let scripts=[['ถึงตาคุณแล้ว เลือกการกระทำ','YOUR TURN'],['ฉันขอรับรายได้ 1 เหรียญ!','INCOME +1'],['ฉันขอบล็อกการขโมย!','BLOCK'],['ฉันขอเก็บภาษี 3 เหรียญ!','TAX +3'],['ฉันขอ Challenge!','CHALLENGE'],['ฉันจะแลกไพ่ในมือ','EXCHANGE']];let [speech,action]=scripts[i];el('bubbleName').textContent=i===0?'คุณ (ผู้เล่น)':seats[i].name+' (AI)';el('bubbleText').textContent=speech;el('bubbleAction').textContent=action+'  ·  ฉากตัวอย่าง';el('turninfo').textContent=`💬 ${i===0?'คุณ':seats[i].name} · ${action}`;mode('focus');selected=(selected+1)%6;updatePortrait(); // camera should focus the speaker not the next selection
 let v=sitAt(i,4.14);targetCamera({tgt:[v[0],2.60,v[2]],yaw:Math.atan2(-v[0],-v[2]),pitch:.32,dist:4.35});activeVoice=i;updateSelected();}
function startDemo(){if(demoRunning){stopDemo();return}demoRunning=true;el('demoBtn').textContent='❚❚ หยุดฉากพูด';selected=3;demoStep();demoInterval=setInterval(demoStep,4100)}
function stopDemo(){demoRunning=false;clearInterval(demoInterval);el('demoBtn').textContent='▶ ฉากสาธิต (ปิดในเกมจริง)';showBubble=false;el('bubble').style.visibility='hidden';el('turninfo').textContent='🎯 กำลังเชื่อมเกม COUP v3 · AI 5 คน · 6 ที่นั่ง'}
el('seatBtn').onclick=()=>{stopDemo();mode('seat')};el('tableBtn').onclick=()=>{stopDemo();mode('table')};el('focusBtn').onclick=()=>{stopDemo();mode('focus')};el('nextBtn').onclick=()=>{stopDemo();focusSeat(selected+1)};el('previousBtn').onclick=()=>{stopDemo();focusSeat(selected-1)};
el('plusBtn').onclick=()=>changeZoom(-1.1);el('minusBtn').onclick=()=>changeZoom(1.1);el('demoBtn').onclick=startDemo;el('resetBtn').onclick=()=>{stopDemo();selected=3;mode('seat')};
let down=null;
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.button!==0&&e.pointerType==='mouse')return;down={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,yaw:camera.desired.yaw,pitch:camera.desired.pitch};cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);cv.classList.add('dragging')});
cv.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!down)return;let dx=e.clientX-down.x,dy=e.clientY-down.y;camera.desired.yaw=down.yaw-dx*.006;camera.desired.pitch=safePitch(camera.desired.tgt,camera.desired.dist,down.pitch+dy*.004)});
function pointerUp(){down=null;cv.classList.remove('dragging')}cv.addEventListener('pointerup',pointerUp);cv.addEventListener('pointercancel',pointerUp);
cv.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();changeZoom((e.deltaY>0?1:-1)*.62)},{passive:false});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{let key=e.key.toLowerCase();if(/^[1-6]$/.test(key)){stopDemo();focusSeat(Number(key)-1)}if(key==='v'){stopDemo();mode('seat')}if(key==='t'){stopDemo();mode('table')}if(key==='escape'){stopDemo();mode('seat')}if(key==='+'||key==='=')changeZoom(-.9);if(key==='-')changeZoom(.9)});
function updateCanvas(){const w=window.innerWidth,h=window.innerHeight,dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,1.65);if(cv.width!==Math.round(w*dpr)||cv.height!==Math.round(h*dpr)){cv.width=Math.round(w*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(h*dpr);cv.style.width=w+'px';cv.style.height=h+'px';gl.viewport(0,0,cv.width,cv.height)}return [w,h]}
function drawMesh(n,m){let g=geo[n.mesh];gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,g.p);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc.aPos);gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc.aPos,3,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,g.n);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc.aNorm);gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc.aNorm,3,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,g.uv);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(loc.aUv);gl.vertexAttribPointer(loc.aUv,2,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER,g.i);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(loc.model,false,new Float32Array(m));gl.uniform3fv(loc.color,n.color);gl.uniform1f(loc.alpha,n.alpha);let texNow=typeof n.texture==='function'?n.texture():n.texture;gl.uniform1f(loc.textured,texNow?1:0);if(texNow){gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,texNow);gl.uniform1i(loc.tex,0)}gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES,g.count,gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT,0)}
function renderNode(n,mat,owner){if(n.hidden)return;let id=n.owner>=0?n.owner:owner;if(n.hideInSeat&&currentMode==='seat')return;let w=mul(mat,compose(n.p,n.r,n.s));if(n.mesh){if(n.alpha<1)transparent.push({n,m:w});else drawMesh(n,w)}for(let child of n.children)renderNode(child,w,id)}
let t0=performance.now(),last=0,viewProj=M(),eyePos=[0,0,0];
function renderFrame(now){requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);let [width,height]=updateCanvas(),dt=Math.min(.06,(now-last)/1000||.016);last=now;let f=1-Math.exp(-dt*1.55),cam=camera,d=cam.desired;
 cam.yaw+=(d.yaw-cam.yaw)*f;cam.pitch+=(d.pitch-cam.pitch)*f;cam.dist+=(d.dist-cam.dist)*f;for(let i=0;i<3;i++)cam.tgt[i]+=(d.tgt[i]-cam.tgt[i])*f;
 cam.pitch=safePitch(cam.tgt,cam.dist,cam.pitch);
 let cp=Math.cos(cam.pitch),sp=Math.sin(cam.pitch);eyePos=[cam.tgt[0]+cam.dist*cp*Math.sin(cam.yaw),cam.tgt[1]+cam.dist*sp,cam.tgt[2]+cam.dist*cp*Math.cos(cam.yaw)];let v=lookAt(eyePos,cam.tgt,[0,1,0]),p=perspective(57*Math.PI/180,cv.width/cv.height,.09,65);viewProj=mul(p,v);
 for(const act of actors){let i=act.index,h=act.human,tm=now*.001;h.group.p[1]=.017*Math.sin(tm*1.2+i);h.head.r[1]=(activeVoice===i&&showBubble?.085:0)+.030*Math.sin(tm*.65+i);h.head.r[2]=.018*Math.sin(tm*.75+i*.7);h.moving.p[1]=(showBubble&&activeVoice===i)?(.09+.04*Math.sin(tm*1.8)):0;let blink=(tm+i*1.73)%4.37;h.eyes.forEach(x=>x.s[1]=blink<.13?.11:1)}
 gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(loc.vp,false,new Float32Array(viewProj));transparent=[];renderNode(root,M(),-1);
 gl.depthMask(false);for(let q of transparent)drawMesh(q.n,q.m);gl.depthMask(true);
 // Floating DOM counter projects a 3D coordinate adjacent to the central pile.
 const badge=el('deckCountBadge'),dp=project([.88,1.77,.14],viewProj);
 if(badge && dp){
   const screenX=(dp[0]*.5+.5)*width,screenY=(-dp[1]*.5+.5)*height;
   if(screenX>45 && screenX<width-45 && screenY>50 && screenY<height-35){
     badge.style.left=screenX+'px';badge.style.top=screenY+'px';badge.style.visibility='visible';
   }else badge.style.visibility='hidden';
 }
 for(let i=0;i<6;i++){let o=actors[i].world,pos=project([o[0],3.52,o[2]],viewProj),tag=el('tag'+i);if(!pos||i===0&&currentMode==='seat'){tag.style.display='none';continue}
  let px=(pos[0]*.5+.5)*width,py=(-pos[1]*.5+.5)*height;let outside=px<-65||px>width+65||py<-60||py>height+60;
  tag.style.display=outside?'none':'flex';tag.style.left=px+'px';tag.style.top=(py+5)+'px';tag.style.opacity=pos[2]>30?.3:1;
 }
 let bubble=el('bubble');if(showBubble){let o=actors[activeVoice].world,pos=project([o[0],4.2,o[2]],viewProj);if(pos){let px=clamp((pos[0]*.5+.5)*width,125,width-125);let py=clamp((-pos[1]*.5+.5)*height,140,height-120);bubble.style.left=px+'px';bubble.style.top=py+'px';bubble.style.visibility='visible'}else bubble.style.visibility='hidden'}else bubble.style.visibility='hidden';
}
mode('seat');updatePortrait();requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);

// COUP v3 live bridge: read-only table projection of the single authoritative rules engine.
let liveSnapshot=null;let lastPublishedTurn=null;let focusLock=false;let followSpeakerCamera=false,lastAutoFocusAt=0;
function safeText(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
// Table cards are public information: all live influence cards stay face-down, including the human player's.
// Only eliminated cards (or cards at game end) reveal their role. The private right-hand HUD shows the human's true hand.
function applyCoupState(snapshot){
 liveSnapshot=snapshot;if(!snapshot?.players)return;
 updateDeckGeometry(snapshot.deckCount);
 let n=snapshot.players.length; // 6 places fixed in this edition.
 for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
   let p=snapshot.players[i];let seat=seats[i];if(!p||!seat)continue;
   seat.coins=p.coins;
   if(el('coinList'+i))el('coinList'+i).textContent='🟡 '+p.coins;
   if(el('coinTag'+i))el('coinTag'+i).textContent='✦ '+p.coins;
   if(actorCoinCache[i]!==p.coins){actorCoinCache[i]=p.coins;rebuildBank(i)}
   for(let k=0;k<2;k++){
     let c=p.cards[k],role=(!c.alive||snapshot.over)?(c.role||'back'):'back';
     if(actors[i]?.cards[k])actors[i].cards[k].coupRole=role;
   }
   let life=p.cards.filter(c=>c.alive).length;
   let b=el('pbtn'+i);if(b){b.style.opacity=life?1:.55;let info=b.querySelector('.pdetail');if(info)info.textContent=(life?'อิทธิพล '+life+' ใบ':'ออกจากเกม')+(i===0?' · ไพ่ของคุณ':' · ไพ่ลับ');}
 }
 let turn=snapshot.players[snapshot.turn],owner=turn?.name||'—';
 el('turninfo').textContent=snapshot.over?'🏆 จบเกม · '+owner+' ชนะ':`🎯 ตาที่ ${snapshot.move} · ถึงตา ${owner} ${snapshot.busy?'(กำลังตัดสินใจ)':''}`;
 const my=snapshot.players[0],myTurn=!snapshot.over&&!snapshot.busy&&snapshot.turn===0&&my?.cards.some(x=>x.alive);
 el('liveTitle').textContent=snapshot.over?'🏆 จบเกม · ผู้ชนะ '+owner:myTurn?'🎯 ถึงตาคุณแล้ว — เลือกการกระทำ':`⌛ ตาที่ ${snapshot.move} · ${owner} กำลังเล่น`;
 el('liveHint').textContent=snapshot.over?'จบเกมแล้ว สามารถเริ่มเกมใหม่หรือเปิดตรวจไพ่ได้':myTurn?(my.coins>=10?'คุณมี ≥10 เหรียญ ต้อง Coup เท่านั้น':'เลือกแอ็กชัน แล้วระบบจะถามเป้าหมายและการ Challenge/Block เมื่อจำเป็น'):'รอ AI เล่น · เมื่อคุณต้อง Challenge หรือ Block ระบบจะเปิดหน้าต่างให้ตัดสินใจ';
 const acts=[['income','Income +1'],['aid','Foreign Aid +2'],['tax','Tax +3'],['exchange','Exchange'],['steal','Steal'],['assassinate','Assassinate −3'],['coup','Coup −7']];
 const current=el('gameActionButtons').querySelectorAll('[data-action]');
 if(current.length!==acts.length)el('gameActionButtons').innerHTML=acts.map(([id,label])=>`<button type="button" data-action="${id}">${label}</button>`).join('');
 for(let b of el('gameActionButtons').querySelectorAll('[data-action]')){const id=b.dataset.action,c=my.coins;b.disabled=!myTurn||(id==='coup'&&c<7)||(id==='assassinate'&&c<3)||(c>=10&&id!=='coup')}
 el('liveCards').innerHTML=my.cards.map(c=>`<figure class="my-card ${c.alive?'':'is-revealed'}"><img src="${CARD_ASSETS[c.role]||CARD_ASSETS.back}" alt="ไพ่ ${c.role} ${c.alive?'':'เปิดแล้ว'}"><figcaption>${c.role}${c.alive?'':' • เปิดแล้ว'}</figcaption></figure>`).join('')+`<div class="my-hand-coins">🪙 ${my.coins} เหรียญ · สำรับ ${snapshot.deckCount} ใบ</div>`;
 el('liveLog').textContent=(snapshot.logs?.[0]||'');
 if(lastPublishedTurn!==snapshot.turn){lastPublishedTurn=snapshot.turn;
   if(!focusLock&&!snapshot.over){selected=snapshot.turn;updateSelected();
     if(followSpeakerCamera && performance.now()-lastAutoFocusAt>7000){mode('focus');lastAutoFocusAt=performance.now()}
   }}
}
const actorCoinCache=[2,2,2,2,2,2];
window.__coupTableApplyState=applyCoupState;
window.__coupTableSpeak=function(data){
 const who=data?.who||'เจ้ามือ',idx=seats.findIndex(x=>x.name===who);
 if(idx>=0){activeVoice=idx;selected=idx;showBubble=true;el('bubbleName').textContent=who;el('bubbleText').textContent=data.message||'';
  const detail=data.detail||'';el('bubbleAction').textContent=/(ไม่เชื่อ|Challenge)/i.test(data.message||'')?'AI กำลังท้าทายคำอ้าง • ยังไม่ได้ตัดสินว่าโกหก':detail;
  // Avoid involuntary camera shifts on each line of dialogue. Optional follow runs only on NEW TURNS below.
  updateSelected();}
 else{showBubble=false;el('turninfo').textContent=(data?.message||'COUP Classroom');}
};

const followBtn=el('followCameraBtn');
if(followBtn)followBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  followSpeakerCamera=!followSpeakerCamera;
  followBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(followSpeakerCamera));
  followBtn.textContent=followSpeakerCamera?'🎥 กล้องอัตโนมัติ: เปิด':'🎥 กล้องอัตโนมัติ: ปิด';
  if(!followSpeakerCamera)mode('seat');
});
window.__coupCameraFollowStatus=()=>followSpeakerCamera;
window.__coupSetAvatar=setPlayerAvatar;
window.__coup3dStatus=()=>({mode:currentMode,actors:actors.length,selected,coins:seats.map(p=>p.coins),cardRoles:Object.keys(tex.front),webgl:!!gl,characterEdition:'step54-real-exported-glb',availableGLB:7,playerAvatar:seats[0].modelId,artEdition:'step5-six-new-cards',tableEdition:'step5-premium-playmats'});
}

// Step 5 gallery works in both WebGL and 2D fallback modes.
(function initCardGallery(){
 const grid=document.getElementById('artGrid'),dialog=document.getElementById('artDialog');
 const labels={duke:'DUKE',assassin:'ASSASSIN',captain:'CAPTAIN',ambassador:'AMBASSADOR',contessa:'CONTESSA',back:'CARD BACK'};
 for(const [key,label] of Object.entries(labels)){
  const item=document.createElement('div');item.className='art-item';
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=CARD_ASSETS[key];img.alt='ไพ่ '+label;img.loading='lazy';
  const caption=document.createElement('span');caption.textContent=label;item.append(img,caption);grid.appendChild(item);
 }
 function show(){dialog.classList.add('open');dialog.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.getElementById('closeArt').focus()}
 function hide(){dialog.classList.remove('open');dialog.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');document.getElementById('galleryBtn').focus()}
 document.getElementById('galleryBtn').addEventListener('click',show);
 document.getElementById('closeArt').addEventListener('click',hide);
 dialog.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===dialog)hide()});
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&dialog.classList.contains('open')){e.stopPropagation();hide()}});
 window.__coupStep5CardData=()=>Object.keys(CARD_ASSETS);
})();

&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/head&gt;&lt;body&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;wrap&quot;&gt;

&lt;div class=&quot;status&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;tag&quot; id=&quot;turnTag&quot;&gt;กำลังตั้งเกม&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;tag&quot; id=&quot;deckTag&quot;&gt;สำรับกลาง&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;tag&quot; id=&quot;aliveTag&quot;&gt;ผู้เล่น&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;tag&quot; id=&quot;coinsTag&quot;&gt;เหรียญ&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
&lt;main&gt;&lt;section class=&quot;topgrid&quot; id=&quot;topSeats&quot;&gt;&lt;/section&gt;
&lt;section class=&quot;center&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;centertop&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;tableBox&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;🂠 สำรับกลาง — ไพ่คว่ำ&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;deckrow&quot; id=&quot;deckRow&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p id=&quot;deckText&quot;&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style=&quot;font-size:11px;color:#bea892&quot;&gt;ไพ่ที่เหลือแสดงด้านหลังทั้งหมด ห้ามดูหน้าไพ่ระหว่างแข่งขัน&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;dialogue&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;who&quot; id=&quot;speaker&quot;&gt;เจ้ามือ&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;said&quot; id=&quot;speech&quot;&gt;ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Coup!&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;explain&quot; id=&quot;speechDetail&quot;&gt;ผู้เล่น 1 คน แข่งขันกับ AI ได้สูงสุด 5 ฝ่าย&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;tableBox&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;⏳ สถานะตา&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div id=&quot;turnPanel&quot; style=&quot;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;gameactions&quot;&gt;&lt;h3 id=&quot;actionTitle&quot;&gt;การกระทำของคุณ&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;actions&quot; id=&quot;actionButtons&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;actionnote&quot; id=&quot;actionNote&quot;&gt;ระบบจะหยุดให้คุณตัดสินใจ Challenge หรือ Block ระหว่างตาของ AI&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/section&gt;
&lt;section class=&quot;bottomgrid&quot; id=&quot;bottomSeats&quot;&gt;&lt;/section&gt;
&lt;div class=&quot;lower&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;logBox&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;📜 บันทึกเหตุการณ์ล่าสุด&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;log&quot; id=&quot;log&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;refBox&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;🗝️ ความสามารถตัวละคร&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;rules&quot;&gt;&lt;b&gt;Duke&lt;/b&gt; รับภาษี +3 / บล็อก Foreign Aid · &lt;b&gt;Assassin&lt;/b&gt; จ่าย 3 เพื่อลอบสังหาร · &lt;b&gt;Captain&lt;/b&gt; ขโมยสูงสุด 2 / บล็อกการขโมย · &lt;b&gt;Ambassador&lt;/b&gt; จั่วแลก 2 / บล็อกการขโมย · &lt;b&gt;Contessa&lt;/b&gt; บล็อกลอบสังหาร&lt;br&gt;&lt;b&gt;Income +1&lt;/b&gt; · &lt;b&gt;Foreign Aid +2&lt;/b&gt; · &lt;b&gt;Coup −7&lt;/b&gt; (มี ≥10 เหรียญต้อง Coup)&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/main&gt;
&lt;div class=&quot;sub&quot; style=&quot;text-align:center;margin-top:15px&quot;&gt;เกมจำลองเพื่อการเรียนรู้ • ไพ่บทบาท 15 ใบ (5 บทบาท × 3) • AI เล่นออฟไลน์ • Challenge และ Block เป็นคนละขั้นตอน และ Block ก็ถูก Challenge ได้&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
&lt;div class=&quot;overlay&quot; id=&quot;overlay&quot; role=&quot;dialog&quot; aria-modal=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;panel&quot; id=&quot;modalContent&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;file&quot; id=&quot;imgUpload&quot; accept=&quot;image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/svg+xml&quot; style=&quot;display:none&quot;&gt;
&lt;script&gt;
&#x27;use strict&#x27;;
(()=&gt;{
const $=id=&gt;document.getElementById(id);
function enginePublish(){if(!game)return;
  try{parent.postMessage({source:&#x27;coup-v3-engine&#x27;,type:&#x27;state&#x27;,state:{
    players:game.players.map(p=&gt;({id:p.id,name:p.name,coins:p.coins,cards:p.cards.map(c=&gt;({alive:c.alive,role:(p.id===0||!c.alive||game.over)?c.role:null}))})),
    turn:game.turn,move:game.move,deckCount:game.deck.length,busy:game.busy,over:game.over,difficulty:game.difficulty,
    logs:game.logs.slice(0,8)
  }},&#x27;*&#x27;)}catch(e){console.warn(&#x27;bridge&#x27;,e)}
}
function bridgeNotice(type,fields={}){try{parent.postMessage({source:&#x27;coup-v3-engine&#x27;,type,...fields},&#x27;*&#x27;)}catch(e){}}

const ROLES=[
 {id:&#x27;duke&#x27;,name:&#x27;Duke&#x27;,th:&#x27;ดยุก&#x27;,emoji:&#x27;♛&#x27;},
 {id:&#x27;assassin&#x27;,name:&#x27;Assassin&#x27;,th:&#x27;นักลอบสังหาร&#x27;,emoji:&#x27;⚔&#x27;},
 {id:&#x27;captain&#x27;,name:&#x27;Captain&#x27;,th:&#x27;กัปตัน&#x27;,emoji:&#x27;⚓&#x27;},
 {id:&#x27;ambassador&#x27;,name:&#x27;Ambassador&#x27;,th:&#x27;ทูต&#x27;,emoji:&#x27;✉&#x27;},
 {id:&#x27;contessa&#x27;,name:&#x27;Contessa&#x27;,th:&#x27;เคาน์เตส&#x27;,emoji:&#x27;❀&#x27;}
];
const ROLESET=new Set(ROLES.map(r=&gt;r.id));
const PERSONALITIES=[
 {name:&#x27;ใบตอง&#x27;,title:&#x27;นักวางแผน&#x27;,speak:&#x27;สุขุม&#x27;,bluff:.10,challenge:.8},
 {name:&#x27;มิกซ์&#x27;,title:&#x27;จอมบลัฟ&#x27;,speak:&#x27;ท้าทาย&#x27;,bluff:.46,challenge:1.25},
 {name:&#x27;พิม&#x27;,title:&#x27;นักสืบ&#x27;,speak:&#x27;ระแวดระวัง&#x27;,bluff:.17,challenge:1.45},
 {name:&#x27;คิว&#x27;,title:&#x27;นักสะสมเหรียญ&#x27;,speak:&#x27;มั่นใจ&#x27;,bluff:.2,challenge:.9},
 {name:&#x27;ปราย&#x27;,title:&#x27;นักเจรจา&#x27;,speak:&#x27;นุ่มนวล&#x27;,bluff:.31,challenge:1.12}
];
const COLORS=[&#x27;#ebca71&#x27;,&#x27;#ba8fea&#x27;,&#x27;#de8b79&#x27;,&#x27;#6bc9bb&#x27;,&#x27;#a6b5df&#x27;,&#x27;#d1a0bd&#x27;];
const ACTIONS={income:{name:&#x27;Income&#x27;,thai:&#x27;รับรายได้ 1 เหรียญ&#x27;,role:null},aid:{name:&#x27;Foreign Aid&#x27;,thai:&#x27;ขอความช่วยเหลือ 2 เหรียญ&#x27;,role:null},tax:{name:&#x27;Tax&#x27;,thai:&#x27;Duke รับภาษี 3 เหรียญ&#x27;,role:&#x27;duke&#x27;},exchange:{name:&#x27;Exchange&#x27;,thai:&#x27;Ambassador แลกไพ่ 2 ใบ&#x27;,role:&#x27;ambassador&#x27;},steal:{name:&#x27;Steal&#x27;,thai:&#x27;Captain ขโมยสูงสุด 2 เหรียญ&#x27;,role:&#x27;captain&#x27;,target:true},assassinate:{name:&#x27;Assassinate&#x27;,thai:&#x27;Assassin จ่าย 3 เหรียญเพื่อสังหาร&#x27;,role:&#x27;assassin&#x27;,target:true},coup:{name:&#x27;Coup&#x27;,thai:&#x27;รัฐประหาร จ่าย 7 เหรียญ&#x27;,role:null,target:true}};
const K_STATE=&#x27;coup_classroom_ai_v3_state&#x27;,K_IMAGES=&#x27;coup_classroom_ai_v1_images&#x27;;
const DEFAULT_IMAGES={&quot;duke&quot;: &quot;data:image/svg+xml;base64,&quot;, &quot;assassin&quot;: &quot;data:image/svg+xml;base64,&quot;, &quot;captain&quot;: &quot;data:image/svg+xml;base64,&quot;, &quot;ambassador&quot;: &quot;data:image/svg+xml;base64,&quot;, &quot;contessa&quot;: &quot;data:image/svg+xml;base64,&quot;};
const backDefault=`data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(&#x27;&lt;svg xmlns=&quot;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 450 650&quot;&gt;&lt;defs&gt;&lt;linearGradient id=&quot;b&quot; x2=&quot;1&quot; y2=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&lt;stop stop-color=&quot;#8d4c3d&quot;/&gt;&lt;stop offset=&quot;1&quot; stop-color=&quot;#2a203d&quot;/&gt;&lt;/linearGradient&gt;&lt;/defs&gt;&lt;rect width=&quot;450&quot; height=&quot;650&quot; rx=&quot;30&quot; fill=&quot;#181224&quot;/&gt;&lt;rect x=&quot;18&quot; y=&quot;18&quot; width=&quot;414&quot; height=&quot;614&quot; rx=&quot;23&quot; fill=&quot;url(#b)&quot; stroke=&quot;#e6bd7b&quot; stroke-width=&quot;14&quot;/&gt;&lt;rect x=&quot;44&quot; y=&quot;44&quot; width=&quot;362&quot; height=&quot;562&quot; rx=&quot;20&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;#ffd994&quot; stroke-width=&quot;5&quot;/&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M225 168l90 72-35 145H170l-35-145z&quot; fill=&quot;#e8c078&quot; stroke=&quot;#ffedb2&quot; stroke-width=&quot;9&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;225&quot; cy=&quot;302&quot; r=&quot;44&quot; fill=&quot;#733f39&quot; stroke=&quot;#fff1bc&quot; stroke-width=&quot;9&quot;/&gt;&lt;text x=&quot;225&quot; y=&quot;488&quot; text-anchor=&quot;middle&quot; font-family=&quot;Georgia&quot; font-size=&quot;92&quot; fill=&quot;#ffe4ad&quot; font-weight=&quot;bold&quot;&gt;COUP&lt;/text&gt;&lt;text x=&quot;225&quot; y=&quot;546&quot; text-anchor=&quot;middle&quot; font-family=&quot;Georgia&quot; font-size=&quot;24&quot; fill=&quot;#f5dab0&quot;&gt;CLASSROOM&lt;/text&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;&#x27;)}`;
let images={...DEFAULT_IMAGES,back:backDefault};
try{let a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K_IMAGES)||&#x27;{}&#x27;);if(a&amp;&amp;typeof a===&#x27;object&#x27;)for(const key of [...ROLES.map(r=&gt;r.id),&#x27;back&#x27;])if(typeof a[key]===&#x27;string&#x27;&amp;&amp;a[key].startsWith(&#x27;data:image/&#x27;))images[key]=a[key]}catch(e){}
let game=null,modalResolver=null,pendingImage=null,labCounts={},labTrials=0,labHistory=[];
let setting={ai:5,difficulty:&#x27;medium&#x27;};
const esc=s=&gt;String(s??&#x27;&#x27;).replace(/[&amp;&lt;&gt;&quot;&#x27;]/g,c=&gt;({&#x27;&amp;&#x27;:&#x27;&amp;amp;&#x27;,&#x27;&lt;&#x27;:&#x27;&amp;lt;&#x27;,&#x27;&gt;&#x27;:&#x27;&amp;gt;&#x27;,&#x27;&quot;&#x27;:&#x27;&amp;quot;&#x27;,&quot;&#x27;&quot;:&#x27;&amp;#39;&#x27;}[c]));
const shuffle=a=&gt;{for(let i=a.length-1;i&gt;0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a};
const pause=t=&gt;new Promise(r=&gt;setTimeout(r,t));
const random=a=&gt;a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];
const roleName=id=&gt;(ROLES.find(x=&gt;x.id===id)||{}).name||id;
const allRoles=()=&gt;ROLES.flatMap(r=&gt;[r.id,r.id,r.id]);
const alive=p=&gt;p&amp;&amp;p.cards.some(c=&gt;c.alive);
const life=p=&gt;p.cards.filter(c=&gt;c.alive).length;
const holding=(p,r)=&gt;p.cards.some(c=&gt;c.alive&amp;&amp;c.role===r);
const winner=()=&gt;game?.players.filter(alive).length===1?game.players.find(alive):null;
const seatName=id=&gt;game.players[id]?.name||&#x27;ผู้เล่น&#x27;;
const face=(role,dead=false)=&gt;`&lt;img loading=&quot;eager&quot; src=&quot;${images[role]}&quot; alt=&quot;${esc(roleName(role))}&quot;&gt;${dead?&#x27;&lt;span class=&quot;deadStamp&quot;&gt;เสียอิทธิพลแล้ว&lt;/span&gt;&#x27;:&#x27;&#x27;}`;
function cardHtml(c,show,wide=false){return `&lt;div class=&quot;card ${c.alive?&#x27;&#x27;:&#x27;dead&#x27;}&quot; ${wide?&#x27;style=&quot;width:111px&quot;&#x27;:&#x27;&#x27;}&gt;${show||!c.alive||game.over?face(c.role,!c.alive):`&lt;img src=&quot;${images.back}&quot; alt=&quot;ไพ่คว่ำ&quot;&gt;`}&lt;/div&gt;`}
function seatHTML(p){const active=game.players[game.turn]?.id===p.id&amp;&amp;!game.over;return `&lt;article class=&quot;seat ${active?&#x27;active&#x27;:&#x27;&#x27;} ${alive(p)?&#x27;&#x27;:&#x27;eliminated&#x27;}&quot; style=&quot;--seat:${COLORS[p.id%COLORS.length]}&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;seatname&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;${p.id===0?&#x27;👤 คุณ&#x27;:`🤖 ${esc(p.name)}`}&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;pill&quot;&gt;${alive(p)?`${life(p)} อิทธิพล · ${p.id===0?&#x27;ผู้เล่น&#x27;:PERSONALITIES[p.id-1]?.title||&#x27;AI&#x27;}`:&#x27;💀 ออกจากเกม&#x27;}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;coinbar&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;coinArt&quot;&gt;✦&lt;/span&gt;&lt;div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;coinsValue&quot;&gt;${p.coins}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;coinsHint&quot;&gt;เหรียญ&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;cards&quot;&gt;${p.cards.map(c=&gt;cardHtml(c,p.id===0||game.over)).join(&#x27;&#x27;)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;cardHelp&quot;&gt;${p.id===0?&#x27;ไพ่ในมือของคุณ (เก็บเป็นความลับ)&#x27;:alive(p)?&#x27;ไพ่คว่ำ — ยังไม่ทราบบทบาท&#x27;:&#x27;ไพ่ทั้ง 2 ใบเปิดเผยแล้ว&#x27;}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/article&gt;`}
function speak(who,message,detail=&#x27;&#x27;){const s=$(&#x27;speaker&#x27;),t=$(&#x27;speech&#x27;),d=$(&#x27;speechDetail&#x27;);if(!s)return;s.textContent=who;t.textContent=message;d.textContent=detail;bridgeNotice(&#x27;speech&#x27;,{who,message,detail})}
function log(msg){if(!game)return;game.logs.unshift(`${String(game.move||1).padStart(2,&#x27;0&#x27;)} · ${msg}`);game.logs=game.logs.slice(0,100);renderLog()}
function renderLog(){$(&#x27;log&#x27;).innerHTML=(game?.logs||[]).slice(0,28).map(x=&gt;`&lt;div&gt;${esc(x)}&lt;/div&gt;`).join(&#x27;&#x27;)}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(K_STATE,JSON.stringify(game))}catch(e){}}
function render(){if(!game)return;const opponents=game.players.slice(1);$(&#x27;topSeats&#x27;).innerHTML=opponents.slice(0,3).map(seatHTML).join(&#x27;&#x27;);$(&#x27;bottomSeats&#x27;).innerHTML=[...opponents.slice(3),game.players[0]].map(seatHTML).join(&#x27;&#x27;);$(&#x27;deckRow&#x27;).innerHTML=game.deck.map(()=&gt;`&lt;div class=&quot;deckmini&quot; title=&quot;ไพ่ลับ 1 ใบ&quot;&gt;&lt;img src=&quot;${images.back}&quot; alt=&quot;หลังไพ่สำรับกลาง&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;`).join(&#x27;&#x27;);$(&#x27;deckText&#x27;).textContent=`คงเหลือ ${game.deck.length} ใบ | ไพ่ในมือ ${game.players.length*2} ใบ (รวมที่เปิดเผยแล้ว)`;
 $(&#x27;deckTag&#x27;).innerHTML=`สำรับกลาง &lt;b&gt;${game.deck.length}&lt;/b&gt; ใบ / 15`;$(&#x27;turnTag&#x27;).innerHTML=game.over?&#x27;🏆 เกมสิ้นสุดแล้ว&#x27;:`คิว &lt;b&gt;${esc(seatName(game.turn))}&lt;/b&gt; · ตาที่ ${game.move}`;
 $(&#x27;aliveTag&#x27;).innerHTML=`ยังอยู่ &lt;b&gt;${game.players.filter(alive).length}&lt;/b&gt; / ${game.players.length} ฝ่าย`;$(&#x27;coinsTag&#x27;).innerHTML=`เหรียญรวม &lt;b&gt;${game.players.reduce((a,p)=&gt;a+p.coins,0)}&lt;/b&gt;`;

function modalOpen(content){$(&#x27;modalContent&#x27;).innerHTML=content;$(&#x27;overlay&#x27;).classList.add(&#x27;show&#x27;);bridgeNotice(&#x27;modal&#x27;,{visible:true})}
function modalClose(){$(&#x27;overlay&#x27;).classList.remove(&#x27;show&#x27;);$(&#x27;modalContent&#x27;).innerHTML=&#x27;&#x27;;modalResolver=null;bridgeNotice(&#x27;modal&#x27;,{visible:false})}
// All gameplay choices are rendered by the 3D-table dialogue panel in the parent.
// The original choice values and rules stay in this engine; only presentation moves.
let pendingWorldChoice=null,worldChoiceSeq=0;
async function ask(title,description,opts,extra=&#x27;&#x27;){
 if(modalResolver)throw Error(&#x27;ซ้อนหน้าต่างการตัดสินใจ&#x27;);
 if(parent!==window &amp;&amp; parent.__coupChoiceHostReady){
   return new Promise(resolve=&gt;{
     const id=++worldChoiceSeq;
     modalResolver=resolve;
     pendingWorldChoice={id,opts,resolve};
     bridgeNotice(&#x27;choice-request&#x27;, {id,title,description,
       choices:opts.map(o=&gt;({label:o.label,color:o.color||&#x27;ghost&#x27;,roles:o.roles||[]}))});
   });
 }
 // Safe standalone fallback if the game engine is run without a 3D parent.

 $(&#x27;modalContent&#x27;).querySelectorAll(&#x27;[data-choice]&#x27;).forEach(btn=&gt;btn.onclick=()=&gt;{const id=+btn.dataset.choice;modalClose();resolve(opts[id].value)})})
}
function answerWorldChoice(id,index){

 if(!p||p.id!==id||!Number.isInteger(index)||index&lt;0||index&gt;=p.opts.length)return false;

 bridgeNotice(&#x27;choice-resolved&#x27;,{id});

}
function toast(msg){$(&#x27;speechDetail&#x27;).textContent=msg}

 $(&#x27;aiSetting&#x27;).value=String(setting.ai);$(&#x27;diffSetting&#x27;).value=setting.difficulty;$(&#x27;startGameBtn&#x27;).onclick=()=&gt;{setting={ai:+$(&#x27;aiSetting&#x27;).value,difficulty:$(&#x27;diffSetting&#x27;).value};bridgeNotice(&#x27;avatar&#x27;,{value:$(&#x27;avatarSetting&#x27;).value});modalClose();initGame(setting.ai,setting.difficulty)};if(game)$(&#x27;setupCancel&#x27;).onclick=modalClose}
function initGame(ai,difficulty){const deck=shuffle(allRoles());let players=[];for(let id=0;id&lt;=ai;id++){const persona=PERSONALITIES[id-1];players.push({id,name:id===0?&#x27;คุณ&#x27;:persona.name,coins:2,cards:[{role:deck.pop(),alive:true},{role:deck.pop(),alive:true}],claimCounts:{}})}
 game={players,deck,difficulty,turn:0,move:1,busy:false,over:false,logs:[],lastAct:null,startedAt:new Date().toISOString()};save();render();speak(&#x27;เจ้ามือ&#x27;,`แจกไพ่ฝ่ายละ 2 ใบแล้ว เหลือในสำรับ ${deck.length} ใบ`,`คุณเริ่มก่อน • เมื่อ AI อ้างบทบาท ระบบจะให้เลือก Challenge / Block / ปล่อยผ่านตามสถานการณ์`);log(`แจกไพ่ ${ai+1} ฝ่าย ฝ่ายละ 2 ใบ • สำรับกลาง ${deck.length} ใบ`)}
function saveWhenQuiet(){if(game&amp;&amp;!game.busy)save()}
function ensureGameEnd(){let w=winner();if(w&amp;&amp;!game.over){game.over=true;game.busy=false;game.turn=w.id;render();save();modalOpen(`&lt;div class=&quot;winner&quot;&gt;&lt;div style=&quot;font-size:45px&quot;&gt;${w.id===0?&#x27;🏆&#x27;:&#x27;👑&#x27;}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;${w.id===0?&#x27;คุณชนะ!&#x27;:&#x27;ผู้ชนะ: &#x27;+esc(w.name)}&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;${w.id===0?&#x27;คุณเป็นผู้มีอิทธิพลคนสุดท้าย&#x27;:`AI ${esc(w.name)} เป็นผู้มีอิทธิพลคนสุดท้าย`}&lt;/p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;เหลือ ${life(w)} อิทธิพล · ${w.coins} เหรียญ&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p style=&quot;text-align:center&quot;&gt;สิ้นสุดการแข่งขัน • ไพ่ที่ยังคว่ำทั้งหมดเปิดให้ตรวจสอบหลังจบเกม&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;choicebuttons&quot;&gt;&lt;button class=&quot;gold&quot; id=&quot;winnerNew&quot;&gt;เล่นใหม่&lt;/button&gt;&lt;button class=&quot;ghost&quot; id=&quot;winnerView&quot;&gt;กลับไปดูโต๊ะ&lt;/button&gt;&lt;button class=&quot;ghost&quot; id=&quot;winnerLab&quot;&gt;ห้องทดลอง&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/div&gt;`);$(&#x27;winnerNew&#x27;).onclick=()=&gt;showSetup();$(&#x27;winnerView&#x27;).onclick=modalClose;$(&#x27;winnerLab&#x27;).onclick=()=&gt;showLab();speak(&#x27;เจ้ามือ&#x27;,w.id===0?&#x27;คุณได้รับชัยชนะ!&#x27;:`${w.name} ชนะการแข่งขัน!`,&#x27;คุณสามารถกลับไปตรวจหน้าไพ่ทุกฝ่ายหลังจบเกมได้&#x27;);return true}return false}
async function loseInfluence(p,why){if(!alive(p))return;let avail=p.cards.map((c,i)=&gt;({...c,index:i})).filter(c=&gt;c.alive),idx=avail[0].index;if(p.id===0){if(avail.length===2){idx=await ask(&#x27;💔 ต้องเปิดเผยไพ่ 1 ใบ&#x27;,`${why} — เลือกไพ่ที่คุณจะเสียอิทธิพล (ไพ่จะหงายค้างไว้จนจบเกม)`,avail.map(c=&gt;({label:roleName(c.role),value:c.index,color:&#x27;danger&#x27;,roles:[c.role]})),`&lt;div class=&quot;flex&quot;&gt;${avail.map(c=&gt;`&lt;div class=&quot;card&quot; style=&quot;width:94px&quot;&gt;${face(c.role)}&lt;/div&gt;`).join(&#x27;&#x27;)}&lt;/div&gt;`)} else {await ask(&#x27;💔 คุณเสียอิทธิพลใบสุดท้าย&#x27;,`${why} • คุณต้องหงาย ${roleName(avail[0].role)}`, [{label:&#x27;หงายไพ่&#x27;,value:true,color:&#x27;danger&#x27;}]);}}else{const strengths={duke:5,captain:4,assassin:3.4,ambassador:2.3,contessa:3.1};idx=avail.slice().sort((a,b)=&gt;strengths[a.role]-strengths[b.role])[0].index;await pause(420)}
 p.cards[idx].alive=false;log(`${p.name} หงายไพ่ ${roleName(p.cards[idx].role)} (เหลือ ${life(p)} อิทธิพล)`);speak(p.name,`ฉันต้องเปิดไพ่ ${roleName(p.cards[idx].role)} แล้ว...`,&#x27;ไพ่ที่ถูกกำจัดจะหงายอยู่ในตำแหน่งเดิม&#x27;);render();ensureGameEnd()}

function decideAIChallenge(challenger,actor,claimed){const copiesKnown=visibleCount(claimed)+challenger.cards.filter(c=&gt;c.alive&amp;&amp;c.role===claimed).length; if(copiesKnown&gt;=3)return true;

}
function wantAIBlock(p,role){const actual=holding(p,role),persona=PERSONALITIES[p.id-1];const diff=game.difficulty;
